title: Quant Market Brief — October 29, 2026: Fed Hold & Quote-Feed Integrity

stories.headline: Learned attention gates strengthen prompt-injection defenses
stories.fact: Heads of Security learns per-head attention gates separating trusted instructions from untrusted data. The preprint reports improved robustness to adaptive attacks while preserving utility in tested models.
stories.inference: Architectural separation may complement application-level trust boundaries.
stories.uncertainty: Preprint results are model- and attack-specific; no defense guarantees security or validates a trading agent.
stories.why: Keep retrieved text outside execution authority and test adversarial inputs.
panels: Untrusted data: process, do not obey
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Shilov et al., arXiv:2610.37657v1; October 27, 2026.
stories.alt: Two evidence panels: Trusted instructions; Untrusted data: process, do not obey. Source and date captioned; conceptual summary, not a calibrated model.

stories.headline: Quote-feed construction can masquerade as self-excitation
stories.fact: A preprint finds that fleeting locks and depleted quotes create apparent sub-millisecond Hawkes excitation in large-tick stocks. Requiring a mid-price level to persist one millisecond removes that component.
stories.inference: Event definitions can change measured clustering before a strategy sees any true signal.
stories.uncertainty: The result is feed- and stock-dependent; persistence filtering changes the event target and can introduce delay.
stories.why: Compare raw and causally confirmed events with identical windows and realistic latency.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Lee, arXiv:2610.36317v1; October 26, 2026.
stories.alt: Two evidence panels: Raw NBBO: fleeting artifacts; Persisting mid-price: cleaner events. Source and date captioned; conceptual summary, not a calibrated model.

stories.headline: Nasdaq futures retreat while Dow futures rise
stories.date: Reuters October 29; 5:18 a.m. ET / 4:18 CT snapshot
stories.fact: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 E-minis -1.01%, S&P 500 E-minis -0.26% and Dow E-minis +0.51% at 5:18 a.m. ET after mixed technology earnings.
stories.inference: Divergence argues for concentration-aware opening-risk estimates.
stories.uncertainty: This reported snapshot is not a live executable quote or depth measurement.
stories.why: Refresh ES/NQ basis and SPY/QQQ auction liquidity before sizing orders.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Reuters, October 29, 2026; 5:18 a.m. ET snapshot.
stories.alt: Zero-centered bars show Nasdaq-100 -1.01%, S&P 500 -0.26%, and Dow +0.51% at 4:18 a.m. CT October 29; reported futures snapshot.

stories.headline: Fed holds rates; two dissenters prefer a hike
stories.date: October 28 statement released at 2:00 p.m. ET
stories.fact: The FOMC held its target range at 3.75%–4.00% in a 10–2 vote. Cook and Hammack preferred a quarter-point increase; the statement describes inflation as elevated.
stories.inference: A hold does not remove tightening risk.
stories.uncertainty: The statement does not precommit the next decision; incoming data can change the path.
stories.why: Separate the confirmed hold from forecast policy probabilities.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Federal Reserve FOMC statement; October 28, 2026.
stories.alt: Two panels show the Fed target range held at 3.75%–4.00% and the 10–2 vote, with dissenters preferring a hike.

stories.headline: Microsoft reports faster cloud growth and higher operating income
stories.fact: Microsoft reported FY27 Q1 revenue of $92.3 billion, up 19%, operating income of $45.9 billion, up 21%, and Microsoft Cloud revenue of $63.9 billion, up 30%.
stories.inference: Growth should be assessed alongside margins and infrastructure commitments.
stories.uncertainty: Cloud revenue overlaps total revenue; growth rates are not investment returns, and non-GAAP earnings exclude OpenAI investment impacts.
stories.why: Compare comparable-period operations, cash generation and capital requirements.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Microsoft FY27 Q1 release; October 28, 2026.
stories.alt: Zero-based bars show Microsoft FY27 Q1 year-over-year growth: total revenue 19%, operating income 21%, Microsoft Cloud revenue 30%; overlapping metrics, not additive.
